steps.caption: Student opens aitufood.web.app: the public home page explains the service; Sign in and Register are in the header.
Register form: a non-AITU e-mail is rejected before any account is created (R1).
Sign in with the student ID only (the form adds @astanait.edu.kz) and the password (demo student account).
The menu loads from Firestore: category photos, dish names, prices; only dishes on sale are shown (R2).
Café staff sign in and see the live dashboard of the ordering day: New, Cooking, Ready columns and day totals (R8).
Student adds dishes (quantity 2 for one), chooses a free 10-minute pickup slot; the bar shows item count and total (R3, R4).
Order #1161 is saved with a unique number; the student is told it can be cancelled within 30 seconds (R5).
My orders: #1161 has status New and a "Cancel order" button with a 30-second countdown.
The student cancels #1161 within 30 s: status Cancelled, the place in the slot is given back.
The café dashboard shows "Order #1161 was cancelled by the student" without a page refresh.
Order #1162 appears in the New column with a "New order received" notice and a highlighted card, without a refresh (R8).
Staff press "Start cooking"; the student's My orders shows #1162 as Cooking at once (R6).
#1162 moved to the Ready column after "Mark ready".
The student sees "Your order #1162 is ready. Pick it up at the café counter." (R6, R7 in-app notice).
After pickup the order is closed: status Picked up, progress bar complete.
Daily report for the café: orders per pickup slot and the top 5 dishes of the day (R10).
Menu editor: staff mark "Olivier salad" as Sold out (R9).
The student menu no longer lists "Olivier salad" (Salads section), without a refresh.
